session.create-image-composition.meaning: Create a new image-composition session, either without a project from the sidebar action area or already assigned to the project named by a project-row action.
session.create-image-composition.scope: The global and per-project creation actions in the Human2AI workspace sidebar. Also used by the home page to create and open an unassigned session.
session.create-image-composition.referent: A newly persisted image-composition session and its initial composition draft.
session.create-image-composition.precedence: The project-row variant additionally establishes the new session's project assignment; both variants are distinct from opening an existing composition session or creating a project.
examples: Create an unassigned composition from the sidebar action area.
Create a composition already assigned to Brand refresh from that project's row.
Create and immediately open a fresh session from a home-page card.
nonExamples: Open an existing composition session.
Create a project without creating a session.

session.create-ui-layout.meaning: Create a new UI-layout session, either without a project from the sidebar action area or already assigned to the project named by a project-row action.
session.create-ui-layout.scope: The global and per-project creation actions in the Human2AI workspace sidebar. Also used by the home page to create and open an unassigned session.
session.create-ui-layout.referent: A newly persisted UI-layout session and its initial UI sketch draft.
session.create-ui-layout.precedence: The project-row variant additionally establishes the new session's project assignment; both variants are distinct from opening an existing UI-layout session or creating a project.
searchTerms: 在项目中新建 UI 界面
examples: Create an unassigned interface from the sidebar action area.
Create an interface already assigned to Brand refresh from that project's row.
Create and immediately open a fresh session from a home-page card.
nonExamples: Open an existing interface session.
Create a composition session.

workspace.unassigned-sessions.meaning: A virtual final group containing every session that is not assigned to any project, shown only while at least one such session exists.
workspace.unassigned-sessions.scope: The project-session hierarchy in the Human2AI workspace sidebar.
workspace.unassigned-sessions.referent: Sessions whose persisted projectId is null, not an actual project record.
workspace.unassigned-sessions.precedence: It follows every real project and contains only unassigned sessions; it is distinct from an empty project and from the absence of all projects.
examples: Show No project last when an unassigned composition exists.
nonExamples: An empty named project.
A placeholder shown when there are no unassigned sessions.

project.create.meaning: Begin creating a named workspace project used to organize sessions.
project.create.scope: Workspace New project launcher and its creation dialog title.
project.create.referent: A new project record, initially without sessions.
project.create.precedence: Opens the form; actions.create submits it. Distinct from creating a session within an existing project.
examples: Open the dialog for a new project.
nonExamples: Create a composition in an existing project.

project.name.meaning: The user-entered display name of a workspace project; project names must be unique among projects.
project.name.scope: Workspace project creation and renaming forms.
project.name.referent: The name of a real project, not the virtual unassigned-session group.
project.name.precedence: Creating and renaming use the same input instruction and uniqueness feedback; project names do not constrain session titles.
examples: Enter a new project name.
Report an existing project name used for another project.
nonExamples: Rename a session.
Edit the No project group label.

session.name.meaning: The user-editable display name of an existing workspace session.
session.name.referent: The selected session title, not its project name or persisted identifier.
session.name.precedence: Renaming preserves session identity and contents; unlike project names, this field does not present a uniqueness constraint.
examples: Enter a new display name for a composition session.
nonExamples: Choose the session destination project.
Change a session identifier.

project.deletion-consequences.meaning: A project can be deleted only when it contains no sessions, and deletion cannot be undone.
project.deletion-consequences.scope: Workspace project deletion confirmation, disabled menu explanation, and nonempty-project error.
project.deletion-consequences.referent: The selected project record and its contained sessions.
project.deletion-consequences.precedence: Does not cascade into child sessions; distinct from session deletion, which removes its drafts and refinement records.
examples: Warn before deleting an empty project.
Disable deletion while a project contains a session.
nonExamples: Delete a project together with all sessions.

session.deletion-consequences.meaning: Deleting a session also removes its drafts and refinement records.
session.deletion-consequences.referent: The selected session and its associated draft and refinement data.
session.deletion-consequences.precedence: Unlike deleting an empty project, this removes dependent session content; it does not delete the containing project.
examples: Warn about related draft removal before deleting a session.
nonExamples: Delete only one node in a draft.

workspace.loading.meaning: Progress and failure feedback for loading the workspace project-session hierarchy.
workspace.loading.referent: Projects and sessions fetched to populate sidebar navigation.
workspace.loading.precedence: Not mutation feedback; retry uses actions.retry.
examples: Show loading feedback while fetching sidebar data.
nonExamples: Report failure to rename a session.

workspace.action-area.meaning: The sidebar section containing creation and feature-entry controls.
workspace.action-area.precedence: Classification or section identity, not an executable action.
examples: Group New project and New composition controls.
nonExamples: Tools for editing the current canvas.

workspace.project-area.meaning: The sidebar hierarchy of projects and their sessions, including the virtual unassigned group.
workspace.project-area.precedence: Classification or section identity, not an executable action.
examples: Display project rows and child sessions.
nonExamples: A destination selector in a move dialog.

workspace.project-actions.meaning: The menu of operations on one existing project.
workspace.project-actions.referent: The selected project row action menu.
workspace.project-actions.precedence: Classification or section identity, not an executable action.
examples: Accessible name for the project menu trigger.
nonExamples: Global project creation controls.

workspace.session-actions.meaning: The menu of operations on one existing session.
workspace.session-actions.referent: The selected session row action menu.
workspace.session-actions.precedence: Classification or section identity, not an executable action.
examples: Accessible name for the session menu trigger.
nonExamples: Editing tools inside a session canvas.

session.composition-kind.meaning: The type label identifying an image-composition session.
session.composition-kind.referent: A composition session in sidebar navigation.
session.composition-kind.precedence: Classification or section identity, not an executable action.
examples: Describe a composition session row.
nonExamples: The command that creates a new composition.

session.interface-kind.meaning: The type label identifying a UI-layout session.
session.interface-kind.referent: An interface session in sidebar navigation.
session.interface-kind.precedence: Classification or section identity, not an executable action.
examples: Describe an interface session row.
nonExamples: The command that creates a new interface.

workspaceSidebar.newUiSketchInProject.role: tooltip and accessible name for an icon-only action that creates a UI-layout session in the named project
workspaceSidebar.newUiSketchInProject.grammar: imperative verb phrase with a project-name placeholder

workspaceSidebar.projectNamePlaceholder.role: placeholder and accessible instruction for project-name entry

workspaceSidebar.projectNameConflict.role: validation feedback for a duplicate project name

workspaceSidebar.renameSessionPlaceholde.role: placeholder and accessible instruction for editing a session name

workspaceSidebar.loadFailed.role: visible failure state for loading sidebar data

home.createUiSketch.role: prominent home-page card action that persists a new unassigned session and opens it
